hints_cache: This problem is a simulation that relies on physical sequence. Since robots only hit what is directly in front of them, start by sorting the robots based on their actual positions on the line.

Notice that collisions only occur when a robot moving Right is to the left of a robot moving Left. If a robot is moving Left and everyone to its left is also moving Left, no more collisions can happen for that robot.
Think about processing the sorted robots one by one. A robot moving Right is a 'pending' threat, while a robot moving Left is an 'active' participant that might smash into those pending threats.

Use a stack to keep track of the robots moving Right. When you encounter a robot moving Left, compare its health to the top of the stack and resolve the 'battle' until one is destroyed or the stack is empty.

To return the healths in the original order, keep track of each robot's initial index. After processing all collisions, collect the survivors from your stack and any 'unchallenged' Left-movers, then sort them by their original index.
